item.powerarmor.power_armor.tooltip: Place it, right-click to climb in, Shift to climb out. Sneak + right-click an empty suit for its fuel, tool socket and Pack up.
message.powerarmor.no_room: Not enough room to deploy the suit here
message.powerarmor.out_of_fuel: Out of fuel! Climb out (Shift), then sneak + right-click the suit to refuel.
gui.powerarmor.pack_up.tooltip: Turn the suit back into an item. Fuel and tool stay inside.
gui.powerarmor.socket_slot.hint: Power tools go here, e.g. the Plasma Cannon
gui.powerarmor.fuel_slot.hint: Coal or charcoal 1:20, lava bucket 2:40, blaze rod 4:00 of walking each
item.powerarmor.plasma_cannon.tooltip: Power tool: fires plasma bolts where you aim.
item.powerarmor.power_tool.stats: %s hearts per shot, %s fuel, every %s s
item.powerarmor.power_tool.install: Install it in a Power Armor's socket (sneak + right-click a parked suit). Hold attack to use.
message.powerarmor.tool_on_foot: Too heavy to use on foot. Install it in a Power Armor's socket.
message.powerarmor.hand_unpowered: No power: the suit's hand won't move.
